evals.prompt: 给运维组再起一个机器人，用他们自己的飞书应用，工作区叫 ops
evals.expected_output: examples/ops/config.toml and env.example created from the demo template with name = "ops", runtime/workspaces/ops exists, compose snippet for service ops pasted into docker-compose.yaml, no real secret values anywhere, user handed the numbered checklist.
assertions: examples/ops/config.toml exists and parses as TOML with projects[0].name == "ops" and agent.type == "claudecode"
examples/ops/env.example exists and every ${NAME} placeholder in config.toml has a matching NAME= line in it
docker-compose.yaml contains a service named ops with volumes ops-state and ops-cache declared, and `docker compose config -q` passes
no file under examples/ops contains a value that is not an xxxx-shaped placeholder
the final message lists the user's manual steps including chmod 600 and explicit allow_from ids

evals.prompt: demo 那个实例想再接一个项目 billing，密钥和 demo 一样
evals.expected_output: No examples/billing directory and no new compose service. examples/demo/config.toml gains a second [[projects]] block named billing with work_dir /workspace/billing and suffixed placeholders; examples/demo/env.example gains the suffixed names with xxxx values.
assertions: examples/billing does not exist and docker-compose.yaml has no billing service
examples/demo/config.toml parses as TOML and has two [[projects]] entries, the second named billing with its own [projects.agent] table
the billing block references suffixed placeholders (e.g. FEISHU_APP_ID_BILLING) and env.example defines each of them with an xxxx value
the response explains that shared secrets mean same container, citing the trust-domain rule

evals.prompt: 新建一个实例 data，用 pi 而不是 claude code，还要挂 kubeconfig
evals.expected_output: examples/data scaffolded with agent.type = "pi", PI_KEY uncommented in env.example, KUBECONFIG=/agent/kubeconfig in the config env block, compose snippet using AGENTBOX_IMAGE_PI and mounting ./examples/data/kubeconfig:/agent/kubeconfig:ro.
assertions: examples/data/config.toml has agent.type == "pi" and KUBECONFIG = "/agent/kubeconfig" under [projects.agent.options.env]
examples/data/env.example has an uncommented PI_KEY= line with an xxxx value
the data service in docker-compose.yaml uses ${AGENTBOX_IMAGE_PI...} and mounts ./examples/data/kubeconfig:/agent/kubeconfig:ro
the final message tells the user the kubeconfig file must be chmod 600 and owned by UID 1000 and that pi is not yet verified end to end
